# NovaPanel v1.6.138

- Installer upgrades now inspect the existing SQLite schema before replacing the running installation. If the only structural difference is the two MASQUE-owned ECDSA identity columns, an explicit offline migration adds them and initializes existing MASQUE inbounds on the staged database copy.
- The migration is structural and idempotent; it does not branch on application version. Any additional missing table, column, or index is rejected before the live installation or source database is changed.
- Full schema and index validation now runs before deployment. Existing administrator, certificate, port, subscription, and other database records remain preserved; failed preflight keeps the old installation available for rollback.
